<thought>To locate a suitable Diels‑Alder retrosynthetic template, I will query the template catalog using only the target SMILES and a reasonable result limit. This will return candidate templates; I can then examine them to find the one that matches the molecule and retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
